svg.title: SmartCrib: training and validation curves over 12 epochs
svg.desc: Accuracy and cross-entropy loss per epoch for the Conv1D model, training (448 windows) against validation (96 windows). Training accuracy rises from 64.7% to 97.5%; validation accuracy from 71.9% to 91.7% at epoch 9 and 10, ending at 89.6%. Validation loss falls from 0.54 to 0.23 by epoch 7 and then flattens while training loss keeps falling to 0.08, the gap that points to some overfitting.
svg.text: Training stopped after 12 epochs at 97.5% training and 89.6% validation accuracy.
Validation loss stops improving after epoch 7 while training loss keeps falling: the gap that points to some overfitting.
